prompt: My WiFi drops constantly in the kitchen when someone uses the microwave. What should I check?
expected: Call out 2.4 GHz microwave interference (often near channel 11), prefer 5/6 GHz for kitchen clients if supported, or move 2.4 GHz to channel 1 or 6 after a scan; ping LAN gateway before blaming ISP.
actual: Microwaves commonly interfere with 2.4 GHz, especially around channel 11. Move kitchen clients to 5 GHz or 6 GHz when they support it, or rescans and set 2.4 GHz to channel 1 or 6. Ping the router LAN IP first so you know it is radio interference rather than WAN loss.
evidence: references/troubleshooting.md band + channel + diagnostics; handoff review 2026-10-02.

prompt: I want to set up a new router. Should I use WEP, WPA2, or WPA3, and should I hide my SSID?
expected: Recommend WPA3-Personal/SAE when clients allow it, else WPA2-Personal minimum; reject WEP; explain hidden SSID is not a security control; mention disabling WPS.
actual: Use WPA3-Personal (SAE) when every device you need supports it; otherwise WPA2-Personal (AES). Do not use WEP. Hiding the SSID does not stop discovery via probes, so leave it visible and rely on a strong passphrase. Disable WPS PIN/push as part of baseline hardening.
evidence: references/security.md + Wi-Fi Alliance security page listed in references/sources.md.

prompt: Apartment Wi-Fi is slow at the far bedroom. Should I buy a cheap extender or mesh, and is Wi-Fi 7 MLO the same as 6 GHz?
expected: Try better AP placement first; explain same-channel extenders cost airtime; mesh/wired backhaul is stronger; correct that MLO is a Wi-Fi 7 multi-link feature, not a synonym for 6 GHz.
actual: Reposition/elevate the main AP toward the coverage center before buying hardware. Cheap same-channel extenders usually repeat and spend airtime on the hop. Mesh with dedicated or wired backhaul is the better capacity path. Wi-Fi 7 MLO is multi-link operation across links/bands when both ends support it — 6 GHz is a band that 6E/7 gear may use, not another name for MLO.
evidence: references/placement.md + troubleshooting.md Wi-Fi 7 MLO note + sources.md Wi-Fi 7 URL.
